title: Preallocate foreign key composite index lookup prefix
description: Replace the foreign-key composite unique-index lookup prefix format! with an exact-capacity helper.

criteria: Composite foreign-key parent lookup prefix remains <composite_index_prefix><value_key>:
Foreign-key helper test asserts exact output bytes and capacity

notes: The helper appends the composite index prefix, value key, and trailing colon without format! allocation.
Generated scan prefix remains byte-for-byte equivalent to the prior format! string.
The change is scoped to parent existence checks for composite unique indexes used by foreign keys.
